description: Read your provider check results as they arrive: one row per NPI with a verdict (needs_attention: a problem; checking: not settled yet and not counted as a problem; records_to_fix: records to tidy; clean: none of these), short findings, every cell with its source link and read time, and the mismatches between records. Use the request ID and the email that sent the list.
name: provider_check_status
title: Read provider check results
